all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The vouched counter credits any blocker-class id in BlockingFindingIDs the ledger holds as resolved, including a carried-forward/foreign one, so it does not strictly bound this run's own blockers; the count tripwire can be satisfied by a decoy resolved id. Hiding a pruned committed-only blocker by padding the section with one already-resolved blocker id would retire the log without an override. This is the pre-existing #147 markdown-trust surface (the new predicate is strictly stricter than the lenient one it replaced); filed, not fixed.
